name: Xperience-10M
tagline: 10,000 h / 10M interaction episodes with 4 fisheye + stereo cams, SLAM poses, depth, hand and body mocap, IMU and 16M caption sentences.

annotations.format: HDF5 (annotation.hdf5 per episode) + MP4 (4 fisheye + rectified stereo pair)
annotations.coverageNote: Per episode: SLAM poses, stereo depth, hand + full-body mocap, IMU, captions. 2.88B RGB, 720M depth, 576M pose/mocap frames; gated, non-commercial.

narrations.note: 16M caption sentences: task / subtask / action / interaction / objects

action_labels.note: Caption 'action' and 'subtask' text per segment; no class taxonomy documented

hand_pose.note: hand_mocap: 21 3D joints per hand + MANO pose, global orient and betas

body_pose.note: full_body_mocap: 52 keypoints, body quats, contacts, root / CPF transforms

depth.note: depth: maps + confidence from rectified stereo (720M frames)

audio_transcript.note: Audio in the videos; transcripts not documented

annotations.sample:
--- annotation.hdf5 contents (top-level) ---
  calibration: group    (cam0, cam01, cam1, cam2, cam3: K, T_c_b, ...)
  depth: group           (depth, confidence, depth_min, depth_max, scale)
  full_body_mocap: group (keypoints, contacts, body_quats, ...)
  hand_mocap: group     (left_joints_3d, right_joints_3d, mano params)
  imu: group            (device_timestamp_ns, accel_xyz, gyro_xyz, keyframe_indices)
  slam: group           (quat_wxyz, trans_xyz, frame_names, point_cloud)
  caption: ...          metadata: ...

samples.caption: One episode in HOMIE-toolkit's Rerun view: 4 fisheye + stereo cams, depth, IMU, 3D skeleton, captions
